children: Rapport Therapeutics closed a series of financings on October 30, 2026, including a public stock and pre-funded warrant offering, $172.5 million of convertible notes, and a $30 million private placement. The company estimates net proceeds of approximately $215.7 million from the stock offering and $166.8 million from the notes offering, in addition to the private placement proceeds. The financings are intended primarily to support clinical trials, research and development, and general corporate purposes.
Agreement 1: Rapport Therapeutics Raises About $216 Million in Stock Offering at $21 Per Share
: Common stock and pre-funded warrant underwriting agreement
: Morgan Stanley, Leerink Partners, and Evercore
: Offering closed; underwriters’ option exercised in full
: Fund clinical development, research, and general corporate purposes
Agreement 2: Rapport Therapeutics Closes $172.5 Million Convertible Notes Offering
: Underwriting agreement for 2.25% convertible senior notes due 2032
: Morgan Stanley, Leerink Partners, and Evercore
: Notes mature Dec 01 2032, unless earlier converted, redeemed, or repurchased
: Raise capital to support operations and clinical development
Agreement 3: Rapport Therapeutics Issues $172.5 Million of Convertible Notes Due 2032
: Base indenture and first supplemental indenture for convertible senior notes
: Through Dec 01 2032, unless earlier discharged or the notes are converted, redeemed, or repurchased
: Set the terms and govern repayment and conversion of the notes
Agreement 4: Rapport Therapeutics Agrees to Sell $30 Million of Shares in Private Placement
: Securities purchase agreement for a private placement
: Raise capital alongside the public stock and notes offerings
Agreement 5: Rapport Therapeutics Grants Investors Resale Registration Rights for $30 Million Placement
: Until covered shares are resold or eligible for unrestricted resale under Rule 144
: Provide registration for resale of private placement shares
Agreement 6: Rapport Therapeutics Issues Pre-Funded Warrants in $21-Per-Share Offering
: Pre-funded warrants to purchase common stock
: Exercisable until all warrants are exercised in full
: Enable investors to participate in the public offering subject to ownership limits
